assistantMessage.text:
- **Outbound delivery:** `webhook.Post` in `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It performs the HTTP request via `safeClient.Do(req)` at lines 119–152. `PostAsync` queues work, and four workers invoke `Post` at lines 42–53 and 182–195.
- **Protection:** SSRF protection in `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` and `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go`.
  - `safeDialContext` resolves the hostname immediately before dialing and rejects reserved/private IPs, preventing DNS-rebinding attacks (`webhook.go:29–37`, `57–76`).
  - `isReservedIP` checks loopback, RFC-1918 private, link-local, IPv6-local/link-local ranges (`validate.go:11–23`, `43–54`).
  - `ValidateURL` also resolves and rejects such addresses when webhooks are created or updated (`validate.go:56–82`; called from `user_service_webhooks.go:71–75` and `158–165`).

Caveat: `AllowPrivateIPs` can explicitly disable this protection (`/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go:38–41`).
